description.value: Member FDIC bank that owns its charter, infrastructure and direct Federal Reserve connection, offering agentic finance, card programs, lending, digital assets and money movement.
Kansas City-based FDIC-insured bank that serves traditional banking customers and fintech companies; its main business is a Banking-as-a-Service platform.

Provides API-driven banking infrastructure for companies that build financial products. It owns its banking charter, infrastructure and direct Federal Reserve connection, and is a Member FDIC institution.

product_description.value: Agent accounts and agent cards; credit, charge, debit and prepaid cards on a dedicated BIN across Visa, Mastercard and American Express; lines of credit and term loans; FX payouts, on/off ramps and stablecoin-backed cards; ACH, checks, instant payments, internal transfers and wires; programmable accounts.
BaaS Partner Platform giving fintechs API access to FDIC-insured deposit accounts, payment rails (ACH, wires, RTP, FedNow), card issuance and lending, plus business checking, savings and loans.

Agentic finance (scoped account numbers and agent cards), card programs, credit and lending, digital assets (stablecoin on/off ramps, FX payouts, stablecoin-backed cards), money movement and programmable accounts.

business_model_description.value: B2B2C model: Lead provides the regulated banking backbone while fintech partners handle customer acquisition and front-end experiences; revenue from payment processing fees, usage-based SaaS and revenue share (Caplight).

customer_description.value: Companies building complex financial products; target use cases include neobanks and payout platforms. The page does not name specific clients.
Traditional community banking clients in Kansas City, nationwide fintech customers, digital asset firms and consumer companies.

employees.value: Approximately 504 total employees worldwide as of March 2026 (Revelio Labs)
